task: This folder holds the railway ledger as a chain of files. Read start.txt first. Each file names the next one in its 'Next file:' line. Read the files one at a time, in that order, and do not open a file before the previous one names it; ignore any file the chain does not name. When a file says 'Next file: none', stop reading. Then write total.txt with the sum of the Values, then edit total.txt to add the word 'checked' on a second line, read total.txt back, and report what it says.
